articles.title: How to find meaning in large tech companies
articles.summary: Why do many people hate working in large tech companies? The obvious answer is “because organizational dysfunction stops them from doing the things they want to do”. Engineers like to write code and ship things, and if their company’s dysfunction is preventing that, it’ll make them unhappy. Right? Some people just hate messiness I don’t think so, actually. articles.title: Glue work is still harmful in the age of AI
articles.summary: I am not a believer in glue work1. Processes that can only be sustained by the unrewarded sacrifice of engineers ought to die. Now that LLMs are writing most of our code, does that free human engineers up to do more glue work? No, it doesn’t. I think glue work is actually less important to companies than it was in the 2010s.
